character: A lean, precise man of thirty-five with fine jewel-toned scaling over his skin, dulled and ashen at the temples, a Vishkanya. A narrow face, courteous and composed. Dark hair swept back, clean-shaven. Pale eyes with a faint cold luminescence. Deeply tired, shadowed beneath the eyes
wardrobe: a well-cut merchant's coat of dark green wool, plain and a year out of fashion, over a high-collared shirt, worn indoors and closed to the throat; no jewellery except a plain wooden ring

full.framing: Full body standing portrait, three-quarter view, calm and composed, hands loosely at his sides.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, head and upper chest filling the frame, facing the viewer, faintly luminous eyes, courteous and hollow expression.

scene.framing: Seated on a white iron bench in a humid glass conservatory crowded with overgrown green plants, an open untitled book in his lap, looking up with a warm welcoming smile as though he has been expecting you.
